baseline.transform: Static relative import prefix ./ replaced with ../../../dist/; implementation bytes otherwise preserved. Baseline and candidate share current dependencies and fixture geometry, isolating physics implementation differences.

environment.keyboard: JSDOM KeyboardEvent with isTrusted=false; synthetic event dispatch, not OS/hardware input
environment.domAdapter: Open, focused pilot surface only. Production InputSession and driverAxes are imported; G non-repeat action behavior is adapted from main.js. Full main/UI event routing is not executed.
environment.solver: Production current and immutable 3.14-physics fixture, each through public advanceFixed at 120 Hz; shared current helper dependencies as recorded in baseline provenance.
environment.geometry: Isolated original ground collider; no city obstacle or route acceptance.

fixture.wheelInitialization: omega = initialSpeedMps / production wheelRadius for every wheel, after settling and before any journal event
fixture.mutationBoundary: All fixture state assignments precede journal creation. No body, velocity, pose, mass, grip, thrust, wheel-state or source-parameter mutation during the recorded interval.

checks.name: 18 pairwise selections cover every ground/air x initial G x 0/20/50 km/h combination
Before and after start with exactly matching declared physical conditions and fixture geometry
All initial translational speeds and all four wheel speeds match the prescribed rolling initial condition
All keydown/keyup/repeat receipts are dispatched JSDOM KeyboardEvents, explicitly synthetic
InputSession records every one of the actual 120 Hz steps without journal eviction
Production driverAxes and applied solver inputs retain held W, E and 1 without repeat amplification or axis loss
Every received 1 request in legal hover mode reaches the bounded pitch-rate path for all candidate sequences
Ground-supported pitch before E or without E reports takeoff-required; the request is retained
Forward and reverse release orders stop only the released axes, without a leftover manual pitch rate
G changes while 1 remains held affect the next physical step; repeated G does not toggle twice
Historical G pitch suppression remains in Before traces and the same sequence physically pitches in the candidate
All sequence integrations remain finite and commands/forces stay within actual nozzle capacities
